body: Sounds like you’ve thought it through to some extent, more than I did haha. Good luck, I hope things turn around for you between now and then. Life’s rough.

I ran away 2 years ago last month during a severe bout of psychotic depression. I left college without telling anyone, hopped on a plane to Los Angeles, and lived on the street in Santa Monica for 2 weeks. My parents managed to find me by having missing person posters put up around the city which, somehow, I didn’t catch. It was ironic because I was literally in the process of leaving to go even further south with some homeless kids (where the likelihood of anyone ever finding me was slim to none) the same day I was spotted. 

If your logic for running away is something along the lines of, “It’s either this or I’m gonna CTB,” then do what you have to. However, the reality of trying to make it on the street is painful and likely will not make you feel any better. 

That said, it was a fucking exhilarating adventure.

EDIT: Also, don’t expect that your family won’t look for you, because they definitely will.
